lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple quasi-parallel horizontal rows across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a low-resolution grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels above and low-intensity pixels below.
